newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa, Bombardier in charter deal.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa, Bombardier in charter deal.

text.p: German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG said Wednesday that it would link up with Canadian transportation and aerospace giant Bombardier Inc. to set up a charter firm for business jets.
The joint venture firm with its Lufthansa CityLine GmbH unit, will provide business service aircraft for charter throughout Europe starting next year.
Lufthansa said the venture would enable the company to expand its service for European and U.S. business travelers, giving them access to destinations not covered by scheduled flights.
The Lufthansa unit had 28 Canadair jets, 15 Avro RJ85 and three Fokker 50 aircraft at the end of 1996, but will use only the jets from April 1997, Lufthansa said.
